ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Psycasts Expanded - Deepcaller
ModMetaData.author: Nidelese
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Deepcaller psycaster path to Vanilla Psycasts Expanded.
Call writhing tentacles up from beneath the rimworld's crust to guard your home. Tentacles earn growth in battle and feed on the fallen, evolving from Sprout to Grasper to Crusher to Colossus with new attacks in each form. Raise an Idol of the Deep, feed its awakenings, and offer gold to cultivate your entire brood. Higher devotion discounts later purchases without a fixed discount ceiling.
Grasp is the precise hold; Riptide is calamity. Turn creatures, vehicles and loose possessions into spontaneous projectiles. Mass, speed and run-up determine what they smash, and collisions hurt both sides. Three separate purchases spare your walls, your people from being thrown, and your possessions from being thrown. Keep the local idol fed to retain each favor. Unclaimed chunks still fly, and spared people can still be hit. Gold can increase acceleration and separately extend the pull area and cast distance. Purchase "Buds shoot non-organics" to teach the ranged brood to fight machines and constructs.
Riptide keeps its speed through the center and coasts onward. Consume now charges heat for the entire offering’s health, wealth and combat power; buy burn reduction and widen its dangerous AoE one tile at a time. Cultivate the hoard with permanent gold upgrades for cheaper ransom, corpse-gear salvage, equipment restoration and taint cleansing.
An area-defense summoner path: control the ground, choose what gets close, and make them regret it.
